title: Kagamine Len — My Cheer For You〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Why did you two fight?
Could you tell me?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I wanted Yu to get better...
So I visited and sang for him every day.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Every day?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah... Yu told me that he had more energy and was even able to finish his food after hearing me sing...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
And my mom said the same thing.
She said people get more energy to fight off sickness when they're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: So I thought... Singing is so amazing...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I thought that if I did my best, I might be able to see Yu at school and sing your songs with him.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But then... Mom told me that Yu is going to a hospital overseas...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Why...?! You said that you've been getting better, that your test results were good...!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Um... Hii, I'm sor—

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: You said you feel better when I sing!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I wanted to go to school with you...!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
You're such a liar!
I... I'm never singing again!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (She must have been singing her very hardest for him all that time, making a wish in her heart...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (At the same time, I'm sure...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't think everything Yu told you was a lie.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Singing... Really does have a mysterious power. Especially singing that has strong feelings behind it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So I really don't think that he was lying about feeling better after you sang for him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: He has to work really hard to get better, and he was getting the energy to do that from your singing.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
I had two shots today that really hurt.
But the pain went away when I heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
I might be able to go home soon.
I'm going to do my best. So I hope you'll cheer me on with your singing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Have you seen him since your fight...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: No. I was going to apologize to him yesterday with my mom there to help. But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: When we got to the hospital, Yu's mom was crying, and my mom went to talk to her...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: She told me to wait where I was, but I wanted to see Yu...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: So I snuck ahead and looked into his room, and...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: There were a bunch of doctors all around him, and he looked like he was really hurting...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I-I... I got scared and ran...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What happened to him then...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
He ended up okay...
But he can't get out of bed by himself anymore.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: What...do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Did he get worse...because I stopped singing?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Sob*
What do I do if Yu dies...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! I-It's okay! I'm sure it'll be okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And I'm also sure that Yu is still doing his best right now.
You can't think like that when he's still fighting!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Sniffle* But...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I can't heal his sickness...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's true... But I think you can give him the power he needs to fight it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So I hope you'll make up with him, and then sing for him again.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I want to make up with him, but...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I'm afraid to see him.
What if he looks like he's hurting really badly again...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If he looks like he's hurting, then that's the most important time to sing for him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
“I'm here for you, you can do it, you can do it.”
Pack all of your feelings into it.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Can I...do that...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Absolutely. I know you can!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This dream you're in right now... It's one you can only have if your feelings are very strong.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, I know for a fact how strong your feelings are!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Okay... Thank you, Len.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But am I going to be able to apologize well...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are you worried? Well then...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. My gift of courage to you!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Your hands are so warm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right? If you get scared or feel unsure of yourself, just think of me.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Okay...
I think I can give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh... That's right. I need to practice singing a lot. I want him to get lots and lots of energy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ooh, great! That's the spirit, that's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... It looks like it's time to say goodbye.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Okay... I wanted to talk to you a lot more, but... I have to go see Yu.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right! Okay then, I'll give you one last cheer!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Go, go, go! Hi-na-tsu!
You can do it, you can do it, Hi-na-tsu!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh! My name...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll be cheering you both on from here!
I believe that your wish will come true...!
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wonder how things turned out for those two...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, she smiled at the end, so I'm sure they're fine.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I hear Rin. Sounds like she's singing again... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But this singing sounds kind of rough...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... This voice is...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's right...! Yu's dad had experience making songs with us, didn't he?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, this Rin that's singing must be...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm glad they were able to make up!
